## Join Certara at PMx Approach Group 2026


We’re excited to share our latest case studies in the PMx Approach Group 2026 conference in Japan. Please feel free to engage with Certara speakers to ask questions about our software and services.​


## MIDD for Confidence with QSP and PBPK


Quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) and physiologically based pharmacokinetics (PBPK) are powerful methods for translating complex biological mechanisms into regulatory-ready evidence and predicting drug behavior across diverse patient populations. Certara’s presentations and posters explore how QSP and PBPK modeling can sharpen dose selection, anticipate patient variability, and build stronger, regulator-aligned evidence for development programs.​
